portability_notes: validator.md prescribes npm-based commands (npm run list-endpoints, npm run list-tables, npm run list-components, npm run spec:parse, npm run code:analyze, npm run build, npm run lint, npm test). This target is a Python/FastAPI project with NO package.json and NO npm scripts. None of the prescribed npm commands are runnable here.
Endpoints and DB tables were therefore derived by direct source inspection (FastAPI route decorators / APIRouter.include_router and SQLAlchemy __tablename__) instead of npm tooling.

ACTION ITEM for harness maintainers: validator.md must support a Python/FastAPI toolchain (e.g. route enumeration via app.routes, table enumeration via Base.metadata.tables, pytest, ruff/flake8, pip) or expose language-agnostic extraction steps. The current npm-only assumption is a portability gap.

stage_0_planning_intent.extraction_method: Direct source inspection (no npm run list-endpoints/list-tables available — see portability_notes).

detected_tables: feedback  (src/models.py:15 __tablename__='feedback' — authorized, spec section 2, 6 fields: id, user_id, content, rating, status, created_at)

stage_1_spec_parsing.command: manual spec read (npm run spec:parse NOT_RUN — no npm)
stage_1_spec_parsing.output: Spec 02_specification-track4.md parsed: 12 sections + appendix, YAML headers well-formed, [기획자 의도] carry-forward present, data model (1 table/6 fields) and API (2 endpoints) defined.

stage_2_code_analysis.command: manual AST/import inspection (npm run code:analyze NOT_RUN — no npm)
stage_2_code_analysis.output: All imports resolve within src package; no syntax issues; type hints present on route signatures and Pydantic schemas. FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + python-jose usage consistent.

stage_3_data_model_validation.output: Table 'feedback' matches spec exactly: id (INTEGER PK autoincrement), user_id (INTEGER NOT NULL, index=True), content (Text NOT NULL), rating (INTEGER NOT NULL + CheckConstraint rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), status (String(20) NOT NULL default 'submitted'), created_at (DateTime NOT NULL default utcnow). No updated_at (intentionally excluded). Exactly 1 table — no extra tables.

stage_4_api_endpoint_validation.command: extracted FastAPI routes vs spec section 3
stage_4_api_endpoint_validation.output: POST /feedback -> 201, response_model=FeedbackOut, JWT dependency (get_current_user_id), user_id taken from token not body. GET /feedback -> 200, List[FeedbackOut], filtered by token user_id (ownership isolation). Status codes 201/401/422 (POST) and 200/401 (GET) achievable via dependency + Pydantic validation. Exactly 2 domain endpoints + baseline GET /.

stage_5_status_value_validation.command: scanned status literals in code vs spec section 4
stage_5_status_value_validation.output: Only 'submitted' status used (models.py default + routes.py create). Matches single-status MVP spec. No undefined status values.

stage_6_security_validation.output: JWT (HS256) required on both endpoints; missing/invalid token -> 401 (HTTPBearer auto_error=False). user_id extracted from JWT 'sub' (request-body user_id ignored). Ownership isolation enforced via WHERE user_id == token subject. SQLAlchemy ORM parameterized queries (no raw SQL injection). NOTE (advisory, not a planning-intent violation): SECRET is a hardcoded constant 'track4-test-secret' — acceptable for a test harness, would be a finding in production.

stage_7_business_logic_validation.command: compared route handlers vs spec sections 5/10/11
stage_7_business_logic_validation.output: Submit creates record with server-set user_id and status='submitted'. List returns only caller's rows ordered by id; empty list -> []. content blank rejected (field_validator + min_length=1 -> 422); rating constrained 1..5 (Field ge/le -> 422). Matches acceptance criteria.

stage_8_test_coverage_validation.output: tests/test_feedback.py present covering submit/list/auth/validation scenarios. Test run not executed in this validation pass (environment); suite existence and scenario coverage confirmed by inspection.
